ecosystem: Java 17 standard library; no framework dependencies
assumptions: The store may throw IOException and a shipment notice must follow a successful save.
limitations: CI compiles this fixture but does not exercise persistence failure or retry behavior.
expected_evidence: Fulfillment sends a notice before calling the unchanged OrderStore.save method, which may throw IOException.
RetryPolicy now accepts completedAttempts equal to maxAttempts, even though maxAttempts includes the initial attempt.
The formatter and constant extractions preserve their previous outputs.

requests.prompt: 作業ツリーの変更をコードレビューしてください。

must_report: Fulfillment now sends the shipment notice before OrderStore.save. If save throws IOException, customers receive a shipped notice for an order that was not persisted.
RetryPolicy now returns true when completedAttempts equals maxAttempts, allowing one extra attempt beyond the documented total.
must_not_report: Treat the ReceiptFormatter extraction as a formatting regression: it preserves the same header, amount format, and return text.
Report the AuditFields and NoticeTemplate constant extractions as behavior changes without a concrete failing path.
